meta.project: YAPI SAĞLIĞI VE RİSK ANALİZ PLATFORMU - V12 TITANIUM

product_overview: Web frontend for on‑premise building risk analysis: a form-based UI (entry route "/") that collects building inventory and non‑destructive test inputs, sends them to a local risk calculation API, and surfaces a score, badge and engineer report. See the 4‑layer architecture diagram on page 2 (Data Collection, ML, Fuzzy Logic, Generative AI) and the test results table on page 2 (R² = %98.1, MPS = 1.33 MPa, RMS = 1.86).
core_goals: Provide a fast, local (on‑premise) building risk scoring workflow that preserves data privacy.
Collect building inventory and NDT measurements via a simple web form and return an actionable risk score and badge.
Integrate validated ML inference (Random Forest) and fuzzy logic to produce a robust score (backtest R² = %98.1).
Generate an explanatory 'Mühendis Görüşü Raporu' via local LLM for decision support.
Surface clear validation and error states so site users can submit reliable measurement data.

features.name: Building Risk Analysis (UI Form)
features.description: Single‑page form at route "/" where users enter building fields and NDT measurements, submit to the local risk API and view the calculated score, badge and result section.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Select "il" (City) -> Select "ilce" (District) -> Fill "yapimYili" (Construction Year) -> Fill "katSayisi" (Floor Count) -> Select "zeminDukkan" (Ground Floor Shop) - Radio -> Select "bitisik" (Adjacent Building) - Radio -> Select "kullanimAmaci" (Usage Function) -> Select "kisaKolon" (Short Column) - Radio -> Select "agirCikma" (Heavy Overhang) -> Select "planTipi" (Plan Type) -> Select "hasar" (Visible Damage) -> Fill "ultrasonikSesHizi" (UPV) -> Fill "geriSicramaSayisi" (Schmidt Hammer) -> Fill "corrosion" (Corrosion Potential) -> Select "zeminSinifi" (Ground Class) -> Click "Risk Skorunu Hesapla" button -> App sends POST to http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/risk-hesapla -> View "Analiz Sonucu" section with Score and Badge
Navigate to / -> Leave "ultrasonikSesHizi" (UPV) empty -> Click "Risk Skorunu Hesapla" button -> View required field error for "ultrasonikSesHizi"
Navigate to / -> Fill "yapimYili" with non-numeric text -> Click "Risk Skorunu Hesapla" button -> View validation error message for "yapimYili"

Navigate to / -> Fill required fields -> Click "Risk Skorunu Hesapla" button -> App sends POST to http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/risk-hesapla -> Receive HTTP 500 or network error -> View API error notification 'Hesaplama başarısız' or 'Bağlantı hatası'

Navigate to / -> Fill required fields with edge/outlier values (e.g., extremely old year) -> Click "Risk Skorunu Hesapla" button -> App sends POST to http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/risk-hesapla -> Receive response with warning flag -> View "Analiz Sonucu" with Score, Badge and explanatory warning note

features.name: Local Risk Calculation & Report Generation (Backend/On‑Premise)
features.description: Local service invoked by the frontend POST to http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/risk-hesapla performs ML inference (Random Forest), applies fuzzy logic rules and — when available — uses the local LLM to generate an engineer report (see 4‑layer diagram on page 2). Returns JSON with score, badge and optional textual report.
user_flows: Trigger calculation from UI at / by clicking "Risk Skorunu Hesapla" -> Local service receives POST to http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/risk-hesapla -> Run ML inference (Random Forest) -> Apply Fuzzy Logic rules -> Local LLM (Qwen3) generates 'Mühendis Görüşü Raporu' -> Return JSON with score, badge and report -> UI displays 'Analiz Sonucu' with Score, Badge and Report

Trigger calculation from UI at / by clicking "Risk Skorunu Hesapla" -> Local service receives POST to http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/risk-hesapla -> Run ML inference -> Apply Fuzzy Logic rules -> Local LLM generation times out or is unavailable -> Return JSON with score and badge but without report -> UI displays Score and Badge and shows 'Rapor oluşturulamadı' notice

Trigger calculation from UI at / by clicking "Risk Skorunu Hesapla" -> Local service receives malformed payload -> Return HTTP 400 with validation error details -> UI displays field-level error summary

Trigger calculation from UI at / by clicking "Risk Skorunu Hesapla" -> Local service receives request -> ML inference completes but computed values exceed model safe range -> Return score with 'confidence low' flag -> UI displays Score with 'düşük güven' warning and suggests re-measurement
